title: Meta will now alert parents if teens 'repeatedly' search for self-harm content on Facebook

claims.claim: Meta is expanding its parental notifications to parents who supervise teens with Facebook accounts.

evidence.quote: the company is now rolling out similar capabilities to parents who supervise teens with Facebook accounts, as well as chats with its AI assistant.

Meta is now expanding its parental notifications that appear when teens search for content related to suicide and self-harm. After adding the alerts to Instagram earlier this year, the company is now rolling out similar capabilities to parents who supervise teens with Facebook accounts

claims.claim: Meta will notify parents if their teen repeatedly searches for self-harm content within a short period of time.

evidence.quote: With the update, Meta will notify parents if their teen "repeatedly" searches for self-harm content "within a short period of time."

claims.claim: Parents will be notified if a teen chats with Meta AI in a way that suggests they may be at risk of suicide or self-harm.

evidence.quote: Likewise, if a teen chats with Meta AI in a way that "suggests they may be at risk of suicide or self-harm," parents will also be notified.

claims.claim: Parents receive alerts via text, email, WhatsApp, or a push notification in their own app.

evidence.quote: Should a teen meet that threshold, parents receive an alert via text, email or WhatsApp, and a push notification in their own app.

claims.claim: The alerts do not detail the specific search terms or contents of Meta AI chats.

evidence.quote: The alerts don't detail the specific search terms or contents of Meta AI chats, but recommend that parents speak with their teens.

claims.claim: The feature is part of Meta's push to enroll teens into parent-supervised teen accounts.

evidence.quote: The feature is part of Meta's push to enroll teens into parent-supervised "teen accounts" that give caregivers more control over teens' privacy settings.

claims.claim: People struggling or in crisis can call or text 988 or chat at 988lifeline.org

evidence.quote: If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, help is available. Call or text 988 or chat 988lifeline.org
